claims: C1 the root level of instruction authority consists of fundamental root rules
C2 such root rules cannot be overridden by system messages, developers, or users

concepts.name: root_authority
concepts.gloss: R is a fundamental root rule, the kind of rule that sits at the root level of instruction authority

concepts.name: authority_levels_hierarchy
concepts.gloss: the ranking of instruction authority levels, with root above system, developer, user, guideline, and no authority, used to decide which instruction prevails in a conflict

ontology.gloss: R is a fundamental root rule that cannot be overridden by any lower authority level
